description: This Java class 'ConnectionValidator' validates connection configurations based on connection type, including address validation, acknowledgement labels, payload mappings, certificate formats, and hostname validation. It supports different connection protocols and integrates with logging and SSL context creation.

classes.name: ConnectionValidator
classes.description: A final class that validates a connection based on its type, addresses, acknowledgements, payload mappings, certificates, and hostname, supporting multiple connection protocols.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ConnectionValidator instance with specified connection protocols.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementLabelsToDeclare
methods.description: Computes the set of acknowledgement labels that need to be declared for a connection.

methods.name: resolveConnectionIdPlaceholder
methods.description: Resolves placeholders in acknowledgement labels with the actual connection ID.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a connection, checking addresses, acknowledgements, payload mappings, certificates, hostname, and protocol-specific validation.

methods.name: checkMappingNumberOfSourcesAndTargets
methods.description: Checks if the number of payload mappings for sources and targets exceeds configured limits.

methods.name: checkPayloadMappingLimit
methods.description: Checks if a payload mapping exceeds the maximum allowed number of mappings.

methods.name: validateSourceAndTargetAddressesAreNonempty
methods.description: Ensures that source and target addresses are not empty.

methods.name: validateDeclaredAndIssuedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Ensures acknowledgement labels follow the correct format and are properly declared.

methods.name: validateFormatOfCertificates
methods.description: Validates the format of certificates and credentials in the connection.

methods.name: emptyAddressesError
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating addresses are empty.
